sections.heading: Local Delivery
body: Finished garments can be collected in-atelier at no charge, or delivered within Douala and Yaoundé for a flat fee, arranged at your final fitting.

sections.heading: Nationwide & International Shipping
body: For clients outside Douala and Yaoundé, we ship via tracked courier within Cameroon and internationally. Shipping cost is calculated by destination and garment weight and quoted before dispatch.
International shipments may be subject to customs duties in the destination country, which are the responsibility of the recipient.

sections.heading: Order Tracking
body: A tracking number is sent by email or WhatsApp as soon as your order ships. Estimated delivery windows are 2–3 business days locally and 7–14 business days internationally.
